source_caption_text:
Kendrick Lamar made a rare appearance in a new video to wish Eastside K-Boy a happy birthday 🎂

**Kendrick Lamar** is a Pulitzer Prize-winning, multi-Grammy-winning rapper from Compton, California, who is widely regarded as one of the most influential and acclaimed hip-hop artists of his generation. Known for his complex lyricism, conceptual albums like *Good Kid, M.A.A.D City* and *To Pimp a Butterfly*, and deep storytelling about West Coast life, systemic issues, and personal reflection, he has earned a place among the top figures in modern music history.

**EastSide K-Boy** (also known as Your Favorite Eastsida) is an independent West Coast rapper and hip-hop artist from the Eastside section of Los Angeles, California. Rooted in LA’s street culture, he first gained traction through his early involvement with rap groups like Bloc Boyz and Glasses Malone’s Blu Division movement. Over the years, he has built a dedicated local following and collaborated with prominent West Coast and national hip-hop names, including Nipsey Hussle, The Game, Dave East, and Kendrick Lamar, with whom he connected early in his career and later collaborated on tracks like “Malcolm X”.
